candidates.explanation: The access-token strategy verifies tokens with 'auth.refreshSecret'. But AuthService.getTokensData signs access tokens with 'auth.secret' (line 619). The signature check always fails, so passport-jwt rejects every fresh access token and the guard returns 401. Login and refresh still work because the refresh strategy and refresh tokens correctly use refreshSecret.

fix.description: Use the access-token secret, 'auth.secret', in JwtStrategy instead of 'auth.refreshSecret'.
